g.aria-label: X-axis titled 'Time (UTC)' for a time scale with values from 23:09 to 23:29
Y-axis titled 'bytes/s' for a linear scale with values from 0 to 4.5M
Symbol legend titled 'series' for stroke color with 11 values: sundial-cadvisor-1, sundial-grafana-1, sundial-loki-1, sundial-node-api-1, sundial-node-sequencer-1, ending with sundial-tempo-1
